text:
maya: CI smoke on main is red for the quantized-inference suite on h100 nodes. Failing tests show kernel launches + occasional OOMs.

oliver: link?

maya: https://ci.internal/reports/2156789 - main job 42. Quick log snippet: 
```
E CudaDriverError: driver version 535.86 != libcuda 545.23
...
RuntimeError: kernel launch failed: invalid device function
...
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory trying to allocate 1.2GiB
```

maya: This started after the infra pin bump yesterday (node image -> ubuntu-2024-03 + driver 545). Some jobs still get 535 from the AMI, so looks like a mixed-driver cluster.

raj: :eyes: are these dedicated h100 pools or shared autoscale?

maya: shared autoscale for nightly smoke. Dedicated for perf runs.

toni: if it's mixed drivers we'll see invalid device function when a container compiled for a newer CUDA runtime hits an older driver. OOMs could be separate (or from bad allocator config after driver mismatch).

maya: can we bisect which commit introduced the image bump? suspect infra/packer change at commit abc123..def456.

oliver: +1 to bisect. maya can you paste the failing job env and the docker base image?

maya: env: MODEL_BACKEND=onnx-quant, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, docker base=redwood-inference/runtime:gpu-2024-03

ci-bot: [build 42] started rerun of job 42 (requested by oliver)

maya: ran a quick repro locally on a clean h100 with driver 545 and it works. On a node with 535 it fails immediately. So indeed driver mismatch.

sarah: infra: can you confirm which AMI bake used driver 545? and whether rolling pool update overlapped with autoscaler keeping some 535 nodes alive?

raj: checking now, looks like image-builder recipe changed driver in packer job on 2024-03-02 (commit def456). Autoscaler did not drain old instances because of max-surge config. We have a rollout window overlap.

toni: workarounds: 1) force all jobs to use a driver-compatible runtime (pin to libcuda 535-compatible build), or 2) force auto-drain/rolling update, or 3) model-side: fallback to a CPU path for quantized tests (slow but keeps CI green).

maya: can someone kick a full rerun on a homogenous pool? If not, I'll open a bisect request to isolate the bake change. Also want a quick smoke that excludes quant tests to unblock other teams.

oliver: I'll trigger a rerun on a dedicated pool (uses 545) and post results. If that passes, we confirm cluster skew.

ci-bot: [build 42 rerun on dedicated-pool] passed

maya: confirmed pass on dedicated 545 pool. So skew.

sarah: infra plan: schedule immediate emergency drain of 535 AMIs in autoscaler groups for staging-only pools, ensure new instances use 545 image. Will coordinate with oncall window.

raj: also opened a bisect ticket: https://tickets/internal/RED-987 - range abc123..def456. assigning to maya + toni for test impact analysis.

toni: for short term CI fix I'll add a quick guard in the quant test harness to check driver version and skip tests with a note. PR coming in 30m.

maya: thanks. can we also add a CI check that verifies node driver == expected before assigning GPU jobs? simple node label or preflight script should do.

raj: good idea. I'll add a preflight probe in the autoscaler that labels nodes with DRIVER=545/535. Jobs can require DRIVER=545 label.

oliver: pinging @platform-team to add the new label to job templates.

maya: ETA for full rollout?

raj: emergency drain + label rollout in ~2h, full cluster consistent in ~4h if no issues.

maya: great. thanks everyone. I'll monitor the bisect ticket and follow up with a short postmortem once we confirm root cause. :thumbsup:
